'''Corvan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. He took part in the [[mission to Sunfall Peak]], setting explosives at the communications hub as part of [[Team Bantha]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
